svg.title: Skipping obsolete terminal painting after scrolling
svg.desc: The pre-parser sees 15 full-screen scrolling line feeds for an 8-row terminal. Reverse lookahead finds enough line feeds to prove earlier text painting invisible. The old text is ghosted while SGR and cursor changes remain ordered. In the terminal grid, prior visible output scrolls off, READY is painted red, and autowrap is disabled.

g.text: 15 individual LF runs are grouped into one block.
Scan backward and count full-region line feeds.
15 LFs for 8 rows prove earlier painting obsolete.
old frame moves the cursor. No cells are written.
CSI 31 m changes the foreground to red.
old data advances the cursor. Still no cell writes.
15 line feeds scroll the full region, row by row.
READY is painted in red at the current cursor.
Visible history is gone. Terminal state is preserved.
